purpose: Create one measurable pass-by discovery lane that recognizes people who naturally see the full system without treating individual GLB names as the audience pull.
postCopy: DigitalHut is a 2026 entertainment dapp system: preview subscriptions, watch a video, use Auto Play, read YouTube statistics, open a 3D Model View, rotate and zoom the model, switch to Next Model, trigger the GLB/podcast feed, search the episode, and see AI system analytics around the story in one interface. It is not a scrollable website. It is a full media session built for people who want the video, the model, the source, the podcast moment, and the explanation together.
shortPostCopy: DigitalHut is a 2026 entertainment dapp system: subscription preview + Auto Play YouTube statistics + 3D Model View + GLB/podcast feed + search + AI live analytics in one non-scrollable interface.
mainFeatures: Subscription preview for DigitalHut access tiers
YouTube statistics and readable live analytics
GLB and podcast feed matched to the episode
Interactive 3D Model View with zoom, rotate, and expand/collapse controls
Next Model and model preview controls
Search feature for episode and category discovery
AI system feature that reads video, model, podcast/source, proof, and backlink context

duplicateTarget.primary: Recognize whether pass-by public-candidate visibility increases subscription preview, Auto Play, YouTube statistics, GLB/podcast feed, zoom/rotate, Next Model, search, or AI system actions while keeping the full entertainment dapp message as the route anchor.
duplicateTarget.secondary: Get first public-candidate podcast, autoplay, search, proof route, or source/backlink event.
duplicateTarget.doNotPromote: Do not treat individual GLB asset names as the content pull.

measurementRule: Compare new events by ref, path, origin bucket, and second-action marker. Stack only lanes where people who naturally see the system continue into GLB, podcast, autoplay, search, proof, or source actions.
